summary: Verified both fixes on mobile viewport (375x667): (1) HpTracker renders exactly 2 rows of 10 hearts (Y=378 and Y=410, 10+10) with equal widths (33px each) using justifyContent:'space-between' + flex:1. (2) Portrait persists across page reload: injected a data:image/png;base64,... URI into localStorage[aob:characters:v1], reloaded the sheet, and confirmed src still starts with 'data:image/...'. HP interactions (tap heart, +/- buttons) work correctly and persist across reload. stat-main-STR present. Character list displays 'N / 20' format. Code review confirms pickPortrait uses base64:true and stores 'data:image/jpeg;base64,'+asset.base64, so the picker path also produces a self-contained data URI.
critical_code_review_comments: Portrait data URI is stored inline in AsyncStorage; a full-size base64 image (even with quality 0.6) can be 100-400 KB per character. AsyncStorage on web (localStorage) has a ~5 MB total quota, so >10-20 characters with portraits could exceed it. Consider persisting a smaller thumbnail (e.g. resize to ~256px via expo-image-manipulator) or using a separate IndexedDB blob store.

pickPortrait hard-codes the mime as 'data:image/jpeg;base64,...' even though the picker may return PNG/HEIC data. Browsers still render it because they sniff the header, but the label is technically wrong.
seed_data_creation: Injected a synthetic character (id=test-char-1, hp=20, portraitUri=data:image/png;base64,<1x1 pixel>) into localStorage key 'aob:characters:v1' to verify portrait persistence without triggering the native image picker.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Web preview uses localStorage for AsyncStorage. To pre-seed a character, set localStorage['aob:characters:v1'] to a JSON-stringified array before visiting /character/<id>. HpTracker rows are indexed by Y-coord: expect exactly 2 distinct Y positions with 10 hearts each and equal widths. hp-current text updates immediately on Pressable onPress; storage save is debounced 400ms.
rca_of_issue: Fixed by main agent: (a) HpTracker now pre-splits the 20 hearts into two 10-element rows and uses justifyContent:'space-between' + Pressable {flex:1}, so hearts distribute evenly regardless of container width instead of wrapping. (b) Portrait picker requests base64:true from expo-image-picker and stores 'data:image/jpeg;base64,'+asset.base64 so the URI is self-contained and survives after the picker's temporary file is cleaned up (the previous file:// URI became invalid on reload).
